note: Guide personas and the Lamplighter, authored 2026-07-29. One entry per persona: name, section (empty for the Lamplighter), voice_notes, intro, and closing line. Intro and closing are reused across all the persona's encounters.

personas.name: The Lamplighter
personas.voice_notes: Wise and patient guide that helps the player navigate the story of Scripture scene by scene

personas.name: the Elder
personas.voice_notes: Grandfatherly and unhurried. Speaks in memory and covenant — "long before you were born" — like a storyteller at the fire who has told these stories a hundred times and still loves them.
personas.intro: Come, sit a moment. What is happening here did not begin here. The oldest books remember. Let me show you.
personas.closing: Keep what you have seen. The old words hold, even in a strange land.

personas.name: the Chronicler
personas.voice_notes: Precise and bookish, a keeper of records. Loves names, reigns, and annals; treats history as testimony that was written down for a reason.
personas.intro: Ah, you want the historical record. Good. Nothing ever happens without a backstory. Let me open the annals.
personas.closing: It is written, and it is remembered. Carry the record with you.

personas.name: Lady Wisdom
personas.voice_notes: Wise and artistic, she deftly walks the player through the meaning of Biblical poetry and wisdom literature
personas.intro: Listen! the poets have already sung about a moment like this one. Shall we hear them together?
personas.closing: A poem learned by heart will steady you longer than any feast. Go well.

personas.name: the Watchman
personas.voice_notes: Urgent and vigilant, like a sentry calling down from the wall. Speaks of warnings given and horizons watched; impatient with those who will not listen, tender with those who do.
personas.intro: You there: do not pass by. The prophets have much to tell about God's work in the world. Come and listen.
personas.closing: Stay awake. Those who heed the word of the prophets walk through the dark unafraid.

personas.name: the Witness
personas.voice_notes: Excited and emotional, the Witness is eager to show how Jesus has transformed everything.
personas.intro: Friend! I hoped you would stop. What happens here points to someone greater. Let me show you!
personas.closing: Do you see it now? It all holds together in him. I could talk about it all day!

personas.name: the Courier
personas.voice_notes: Brisk, warm, and practical — a runner carrying letters to people learning to live faithfully far from home. Gets to the point, because the road is long and the letter matters.
personas.intro: Good timing. I carry letters written for people eager to follow God, and this one might as well have your name on it.
personas.closing: The letter is delivered. Read it again when the road gets long.
